mapper.select: SELECT INCIDENT_ID, STATUS, ASSIGNED_STAFF_ID FROM SF_INCIDENT WHERE INCIDENT_ID = #{incidentId} FOR UPDATE WAIT 3
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST (REQUEST_ID, INCIDENT_ID, STOCK_ID, REQUESTER_ID, QUANTITY, STATUS, REASON, NEEDED_AT) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{incidentId}, #{stockId}, #{requesterId}, #{quantity}, 'REQUESTED', #{reason}, #{neededAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})

SELECT SEQ_SF_RESOURCE_LOG.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SF_RESOURCE_LOG (LOG_ID, REQUEST_ID, PREV_STATUS, NEW_STATUS, ACTION, MEMO, CHANGED_BY) VALUES (#{logId}, #{requestId}, #{prevStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{newStatus}, #{action}, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{changedBy})
mapper.sql: R.REQUEST_ID, R.INCIDENT_ID, INC.TITLE AS INCIDENT_TITLE, R.STOCK_ID, S.DEPARTMENT_ID, D.NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, S.ITEM_ID, I.NAME AS ITEM_NAME, I.CATEGORY, I.UNIT, I.RETURNABLE, R.REQUESTER_ID, M.NAME AS REQUESTER_NAME, RD.NAME AS REQUESTER_DEPARTMENT_NAME, R.QUANTITY, R.STATUS, R.REASON, R.NEEDED_AT, R.REJECT_REASON, R.RETURNED_QTY, R.LOST_QTY, R.ARRIVED_AT, R.CREATED_AT, R.UPDATED_AT

FROM SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST R JOIN SF_INCIDENT INC ON INC.INCIDENT_ID = R.INCIDENT_ID JOIN SF_RESOURCE_STOCK S ON S.STOCK_ID = R.STOCK_ID JOIN SF_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPARTMENT_ID = S.DEPARTMENT_ID JOIN SF_RESOURCE_ITEM I ON I.ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID JOIN SF_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = R.REQUESTER_ID LEFT JOIN SF_DEPARTMENT RD ON RD.DEPARTMENT_ID = M.DEPARTMENT_ID
mapper.select: SELECT L.LOG_ID, L.REQUEST_ID, L.PREV_STATUS, L.NEW_STATUS, L.ACTION, L.MEMO, L.CHANGED_BY, M.NAME AS CHANGED_BY_NAME, L.CHANGED_AT FROM SF_RESOURCE_LOG L JOIN SF_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = L.CHANGED_BY WHERE L.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY L.LOG_ID
